description: Convenience check: given an identifier, report whether a readable (full-view) scanned copy exists on HathiTrust, how many copies are readable, and direct reading URLs. Keyless. Requires a free Pipeworx account (https://pipeworx.io/signup); anonymous and X-API-Key-only calls are refused.

id.description: The identifier value, e.g. "2364951" for an OCLC number.

id_type.description: Identifier type. One of: oclc, lccn, issn, isbn, htid, recordnumber.

name: check_full_view
